paragraphs: R' Yohanan ben Nuri, the well-known Tanna — Kilayim; Kilayim, chapter 6, mishnah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Both occurrences of Kilayim remain; their repetition is not silently resolved as a catchword or dittography. פ״ו מ״א explicitly gives chapter 6, mishnah 1, without independent named-edition verification.
The bare Nuri heading is a collection heading, not an independent identity claim. The well-known Tanna description remains attributed to the source; the abbreviated title remains R'.
